items.text: Tested it on a murky creek behind our cabin before putting it in our hurricane bin. Dropped the pre-filter in, hit the button once, and filled three 32 oz bottles in under three minutes. The water came out completely clear with zero pond taste.

Trying to get small family members to suck water through a stiff straw during a camping trip is miserable. With this electric pump I just clip the outlet hose to our 1-gallon jug, press the button, and everyone has clean drinking water.

Every hurricane season in Florida our supermarket shelves empty out in two hours. Having two of these 793-gallon systems, one under the kitchen sink and one in my truck, gives us 1,586 gallons of clean water without storing pallets of plastic.

Brought this on a 3-day backcountry loop in Colorado. Instead of five guys hunched over a freezing stream with squeeze bags, we sat on a log while this pumped crystal-clear water into everyone's Nalgenes. Battery still had plenty of charge left.
My old 0.2-micron straw always left creek water tasting like wet leaves. The 6-stage filter with coconut activated carbon in this unit pulls out both the brownish tannin tint and the earthy smell.

Ordered the 2-Kit Reserve so my wife has one at home and I keep one in my F-150 overland kit. Everything zips neatly into the hard pouch, the hoses are labeled clearly, and the LED work light is super bright when filtering after dark.

items.question: What does the 6-stage 0.01-micron filter actually remove?
items.answer: The 6-stage system combines a weighted sediment pre-filter cage, dual PP cotton layers, a 0.01-micron (10 nm) hollow-fiber ultrafiltration membrane, and coconut-shell activated carbon. At 0.01 microns (20× finer than standard 0.2-micron personal straws), it blocks 99.999% of sediment, silt, rust, bacteria, protozoa (including Giardia and Cryptosporidium), and microplastics while reducing odors and chlorine taste.

items.question: How fast does it pump, and how much water can one charge filter?
items.answer: Pressing the power button delivers a steady 500–700 mL/min (16.9–23.6 fl oz/min) flow rate, filling a standard 16.9 oz water bottle in under 60 seconds. A single full USB-C charge filters up to 42 gallons (160 liters) of water, enough for 10–14 days of family drinking water before recharging from any USB-C power bank, car port, or solar panel.

items.answer: Each internal cartridge set is rated for up to 793 gallons (3,000 liters) of water, equivalent to roughly 6,000 standard 500 mL single-use plastic water bottles. The twist-lock housing opens in seconds for backflushing or swapping cartridges.

items.question: What water sources can I use it with?
items.answer: It is designed for freshwater sources including rivers, lakes, creeks, streams, rainwater collection barrels, and municipal tap water during boil-water advisories or storms. If filtering heavily muddy floodwater, let coarse mud settle in a bucket for 10 minutes first so the pre-filter stays clear. Do not use with ocean saltwater or chemical industrial runoff.

items.question: How do I clean and store it after using it outdoors?
items.answer: After filtering, lift the intake hose out of the water and let the pump run for 10–15 seconds to push remaining water out of the hoses, then run a cup of clean water through to flush sediment from the pre-filter cage. Let the silicone hoses air-dry before zipping everything back into the hard carry case.
